description.text: Objectives The undergraduate program in International Trade and Economics provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge in economics and international trade. The program covers business related issues such as Chinese culture, China's policies on foreign trade, and China’s major trading partners. Students should be able to engage in various business, management, and international trade activities in government agencies or multinational companies. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Politics & Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Accounting, World Economics, International Trade Practice, Monetary Banking, Finance. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The International Trade and Economics at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
